description: Repositories: Jidoka and jido_cli. Test CLI once against the sibling Jidoka checkout and once against the exact pinned revision. Extend archive acceptance so the extracted local artifact runs the provider-free coding scenario in an external writable workspace. Acceptance: pin names the tested Jidoka commit; package stays read-only; no system Erlang, Elixir, or Mix is used; repository oracle passes.
title: Add cross-repository gates and exact local-artifact acceptance
